articles.title_en: Measuring Absolute Income Mobility: Lessons from North America and Europe
articles.title_cn: 衡量绝对收入流动性：来自北美和欧洲的经验
articles.abstract_en: We use linked parent–child administrative data for five countries in North America and Europe, as well as detailed survey data for two more, to investigate methodological challenges in the estimation of absolute income mobility. We show that the commonly used “copula and marginals” approximation methods perform well across countries in our sample, and the greatest challenges to their accuracy stem not from assumptions about relative mobility rates over time but from the use of nonrepresentative marginal income distributions. We also provide a multicountry analysis of sensitivity to specification decisions related to age of income measurement, income concept, family structure, and price index. (JEL D31, G51, I31, J12, J31, J62)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们使用北美和欧洲五个国家的关联父母-子女行政数据，以及另外两个国家的详细调查数据，来研究估计绝对收入流动性时面临的方法论挑战。我们表明，在我们样本中的各国，常用的“连接函数和边际分布”近似方法表现良好，而其准确性的最大挑战并非源于对相对流动性随时间变化的假设，而是源于使用非代表性的边际收入分布。我们还提供了对与收入测量年龄、收入概念、家庭结构和价格指数相关的规格决策敏感性的多国分析。（JEL D31, G51, I31, J12, J31, J62）

articles.title_en: Predistribution versus Redistribution: Evidence from France and the United States
articles.title_cn: 预分配与再分配：来自法国和美国的证据
articles.abstract_en: We construct series of posttax income for France over the 1900–2018 period and compare them with US series. We quantify the extent of redistribution—the reduction from pretax to posttax inequality—and estimate the contribution of redistribution in explaining differences in posttax inequality. We find that differences in pretax inequality drive most of the differences in posttax inequality between France and the United States, and that changes over time in both countries are mostly due to changes in pretax inequality. We highlight that the concept of redistribution can be empirically misleading for judging how policies reduce inequalities. (JEL D31, H23, H24, H31, I38)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们构建了法国1900-2018年期间的税后收入序列，并与美国序列进行比较。我们量化了再分配的程度——从税前不平等减少到税后不平等——并估计了再分配在解释税后不平等差异中的贡献。我们发现，税前不平等的差异驱动了法国和美国之间税后不平等差异的大部分，并且两国随时间的变化主要归因于税前不平等的变化。我们强调，再分配的概念在经验上可能具有误导性，用于判断政策如何减少不平等。(JEL D31, H23, H24, H31, I38)

articles.title_en: Intergenerational Mobility in India: New Measures and Estimates across Time and Social Groups
articles.title_cn: 印度的代际流动性：跨时间和社会群体的新度量与估计
articles.abstract_en: We study intergenerational mobility in India. We propose a new measure of upward mobility: the expected education rank of a child born to parents in the bottom half of the education distribution. This measure works well under data constraints common in developing countries and historical contexts. Intergenerational mobility in India has been constant and low since before liberalization. Among sons, we observe rising mobility for Scheduled Castes and declining mobility among Muslims. Daughters’ intergenerational mobility is lower than sons’, with less cross-group variation over time. A natural experiment suggests that affirmative action for Scheduled Castes has substantially improved their mobility. (JEL I24, J13, J15, J16, J62, O12, Z12)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究印度的代际流动性。我们提出了一种新的向上流动性度量：出生于教育分布下半部分的父母所生育子女的预期教育排名。该度量在发展中国家和历史背景下常见的数据约束下表现良好。自自由化以来，印度的代际流动性一直保持低位且稳定。在儿子中，我们观察到表列种姓的流动性上升，而穆斯林的流动性下降。女儿的代际流动性低于儿子，且跨群体随时间的变化较小。一项自然实验表明，针对表列种姓的平权行动显著提高了他们的流动性。（JEL I24, J13, J15, J16, J62, O12, Z12）

articles.title_cn: 财富的代际传递：佛罗伦萨，1403-1480年
articles.abstract_en: By using hand-collected data on households’ wealth assessments, we study multigenerational mobility in Florence during the late Middle Ages. We find that Florentine society was more mobile than one would expect but also that multigenerational mobility was lower than implied by two-generation estimates. We reconcile these findings by showing their consistency with a model where wealth transmission is governed by an unobserved latent factor. We also show that, given our estimates, this model is compatible with the long run persistence obtained by previous studies. Finally, we find that participation in marriage networks and politics correlates with persistence of economic status across generations. (JEL D31, G51, J12, J62, N33)
articles.abstract_cn: 通过使用手工收集的家庭财富评估数据，我们研究了中世纪晚期佛罗伦萨的代际流动性。我们发现佛罗伦萨社会的流动性高于预期，但代际流动性低于两代估计所暗示的水平。我们通过展示这些发现与一个由未观测潜在因子支配财富传递的模型的一致性来调和这些结果。我们还表明，根据我们的估计，该模型与先前研究获得的长期持续性兼容。最后，我们发现参与婚姻网络和政治与跨代经济地位的持续性相关。（JEL D31, G51, J12, J62, N33）

articles.title_en: Housing the Homeless: The Effect of Placing Single Adults Experiencing Homelessness in Housing Programs on Future Homelessness and Socioeconomic Outcomes
articles.title_cn: 安置无家可归者：将无家可归的单身成年人安置到住房项目对未来无家可归和社会经济结果的影响
articles.abstract_en: This study measures the impact of rapidly placing single adults experiencing homelessness in housing programs on future homelessness, crime, and health. Using a caseworker placement tendencies design and a novel dataset constructed by linking administrative records from multiple public agencies in Los Angeles County, I estimate that rapidly placing individuals in housing programs significantly reduces the likelihood of future return to the homeless support system, crime, and reliance on emergency cash assistance, yet it does not have a detectable effect on health services utilization. These findings demonstrate that rapid housing placements can have both rehabilitative and potentially cost-saving impacts. (JEL H75, I12, I38, K42, R23, R38)
articles.abstract_cn: 本研究衡量了将无家可归的单身成年人迅速安置到住房项目对未来无家可归、犯罪和健康的影响。利用个案工作者安置倾向设计以及通过关联洛杉矶县多个公共机构的行政记录构建的新数据集，我估计迅速将个人安置到住房项目显著降低了未来返回无家可归支持系统、犯罪和对紧急现金援助依赖的可能性，但对卫生服务利用没有可检测的影响。这些发现表明，快速住房安置可以产生康复和潜在节省成本的影响。(JEL H75, I12, I38, K42, R23, R38)

articles.title_en: The Short- and the Long-Run Impact of Gender-Biased Teachers
articles.title_cn: 性别偏见教师的短期与长期影响
articles.abstract_en: We examine the persistence of teachers’ gender biases by following teachers over time in different classes. We find a very high correlation of gender biases for teachers across their classes. We find a substantial impact of gender bias on student performance in university admissions exams, choice of university field of study, and quality of the enrolled program. The effects on university choice outcomes are larger for girls, explaining some gender differences in STEM majors. Teachers with lower value-added are also more likely to be gender biased. (JEL I21, I23, J16, J24, J45)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们通过跟踪教师在不同班级中的表现来考察教师性别偏见的持续性。我们发现教师在其所教班级中的性别偏见具有非常高的相关性。我们发现性别偏见对学生大学入学考试成绩、大学专业选择以及所录取项目质量有显著影响。对大学选择结果的影响对女孩更大，这解释了STEM专业中的一些性别差异。增值较低的教师也更可能具有性别偏见。（JEL I21, I23, J16, J24, J45）

articles.title_en: Private Input Suppliers as Information Agents for Technology Adoption in Agriculture
articles.title_cn: 私营投入品供应商作为农业技术采纳的信息中介
articles.abstract_en: Information frictions limit the adoption of new agricultural technologies in developing countries. Efforts to improve learning involve spreading information from government agents to farmers. We show that when compared to this government approach, informing private input suppliers in India about a new seed variety increases farmer-level adoption by over 50 percent. Suppliers become more proactive in informing potential customers and carrying the new variety. They induce increased adoption by those with higher returns from the technology. Being motivated by expanded sales offers the most likely motive for these results. (JEL D83, L14, L33, O13, O32, Q12, Q16)
articles.abstract_cn: 信息摩擦限制了发展中国家新农业技术的采纳。改善学习的努力涉及将信息从政府机构传播给农民。我们表明，与这种政府方法相比，在印度告知私营投入品供应商关于新种子品种的信息，使农户层面的采纳率提高了超过50%。供应商在告知潜在客户和携带新品种方面变得更加主动。他们促使那些从技术中获得更高回报的人增加采纳。受扩大销售的激励是这些结果最可能的动机。(JEL D83, L14, L33, O13, O32, Q12, Q16)

articles.title_en: Does Promoting One Healthy Behavior Detract from Others? Evidence from a Field Experiment
articles.title_cn: 促进一种健康行为是否会减损其他行为？来自实地实验的证据
articles.abstract_en: Impact evaluations of behavioral interventions typically focus on target outcomes. Might interventions induce negative spillovers on other behaviors? I run a large field experiment in which individuals receive combinations of messages and incentives promoting two healthy behaviors, meditation and meal logging. I find that the interventions reduce completion rates of the opposite behavior by 19–29 percent. I find that interventions with larger target effects do not necessarily generate larger negative spillovers, and demonstrate implications for cost-effectiveness analysis. I investigate the mechanisms behind the observed spillovers. (JEL C93, D62, D91, I12)
articles.abstract_cn: 行为干预的影响评估通常聚焦于目标结果。干预措施是否可能对其他行为产生负面溢出效应？我进行了一项大型实地实验，其中个体接受结合信息和激励的干预，以促进两种健康行为：冥想和记录饮食。我发现这些干预措施将相反行为的完成率降低了19-29%。我发现，具有更大目标效应的干预措施不一定产生更大的负面溢出效应，并展示了这对成本效益分析的意义。我调查了观察到的溢出效应背后的机制。（JEL C93, D62, D91, I12）

articles.title_en: SeaTE: Subjective ex ante Treatment Effect of Health on Retirement
articles.title_cn: SeaTE：健康对退休影响的主观事前处理效应
articles.abstract_en: The paper studies the effect of health on work among older workers by eliciting two- and four-year-ahead subjective probabilities of working under alternative health states. These measures predict work outcomes. Person-specific differences in working probabilities across health states can be interpreted as Subjective ex ante Treatment Effects (SeaTEs) in a potential outcomes framework and as taste for work within a discrete choice dynamic programming framework. There is substantial heterogeneity in expectations of work conditional on health. The paper shows how heterogeneity in taste for work correlated with health can bias regression estimates of the effect of health on retirement. (JEL D84, I12, J14, J22, J26)
articles.abstract_cn: 本文通过引出在替代健康状态下未来两年和四年工作主观概率，研究了健康对老年工人工作的影响。这些指标预测了工作结果。在不同健康状态下工作概率的个体特定差异可以解释为潜在结果框架中的主观事前处理效应（SeaTEs），以及在离散选择动态规划框架中对工作的偏好。在健康条件下，工作预期存在显著的异质性。本文展示了与健康相关的对工作偏好的异质性如何使健康对退休影响的回归估计产生偏误。（JEL D84, I12, J14, J22, J26）

articles.title_en: How the Internet Changed the Market for Print Media
articles.title_cn: 互联网如何改变印刷媒体市场
articles.abstract_en: Combining rich data from the Norwegian media market with exogenous variation in the availability and adoption of broadband internet, this paper provides causal evidence on how the internet affected traditional print media. Broadband internet adoption triggered large reductions in print readership and circulation and equally large increases in online news readership. Despite strong substitution from print to online news consumption, newspaper revenues fell dramatically. Newspapers responded to this adverse technology shock along multiple dimensions, including cutting costs by reducing labor inputs and the physical newspaper size and changing the print product available to customers by reducing tabloid content share. (JEL D24, L13, L25, L82, L86, O33)
articles.abstract_cn: 结合挪威媒体市场的丰富数据以及宽带互联网可用性和普及的外生变化，本文提供了关于互联网如何影响传统印刷媒体的因果证据。宽带互联网的普及引发了印刷品读者数量和发行量的大幅下降，同时在线新闻读者数量也出现了同等规模的增长。尽管从印刷品到在线新闻消费存在强烈的替代效应，报纸收入仍大幅下降。报纸在多个维度上应对了这一不利的技术冲击，包括通过减少劳动投入和缩小报纸实体尺寸来削减成本，以及通过减少小报内容份额来改变提供给客户的印刷产品。(JEL D24, L13, L25, L82, L86, O33)

articles.title_en: What’s Behind Her Smile? Health, Looks, and Self-Esteem
articles.title_cn: 她微笑的背后是什么？健康、外貌与自尊
articles.abstract_en: This paper examines how improving dental health affects economic, social, and psychological outcomes. In a randomized experiment, we provide a low-income group free dental care, including prostheses, and find significant and persistent impacts on men’s and women’s dental and self-perceived mental health. For women, treatment generates improvement in self-esteem, a higher likelihood of smiling when photographed, short-run improvements in employment and earnings, and improvement in partner interactions. We find no impact for men in these dimensions. Heterogeneity analyses suggest that treatment effects on labor market outcomes are larger for women with more severe visible dental issues at baseline. (JEL D12, D91, I12, J16, O12)
articles.abstract_cn: 本文研究了改善牙齿健康如何影响经济、社会和心理结果。在一项随机实验中，我们为低收入群体提供免费牙科护理，包括假牙，并发现对男性和女性的牙齿健康及自我感知的心理健康产生了显著且持久的影响。对于女性，治疗提高了自尊，拍照时更可能微笑，短期内改善了就业和收入，并改善了与伴侣的互动。我们未发现对男性在这些方面有影响。异质性分析表明，对于基线时牙齿问题更严重的女性，治疗对劳动力市场结果的影响更大。（JEL D12, D91, I12, J16, O12）

articles.title_en: The Effects of Roads on Trade and Migration: Evidence from a Planned Capital City
articles.title_cn: 道路对贸易和迁移的影响：来自规划首都的证据
articles.abstract_en: A large body of literature studies how infrastructure facilitates trade. We ask whether infrastructure also facilitates migration. Using a general equilibrium trade model and rich spatial data, we study the impact of a large, plausibly exogenous shock to highways in Brazil on both goods and labor markets. We find the highway system increased welfare by 2.8 percent, of which 76 percent was due to reduced trade costs and 24 percent to reduced migration costs. An implication of costly migration is spatial heterogeneity in benefits: the range of welfare improvement is 1 to 15 percent, as opposed to uniform gains with perfect mobility. (JEL H54, H76, O18, R23, R42, R53)
articles.abstract_cn: 大量文献研究基础设施如何促进贸易。我们探讨基础设施是否也促进迁移。利用一般均衡贸易模型和丰富的空间数据，我们研究了巴西高速公路的一次大型、看似外生的冲击对商品市场和劳动力市场的影响。我们发现高速公路系统使福利提高了2.8%，其中76%归因于贸易成本降低，24%归因于迁移成本降低。昂贵迁移的一个含义是福利收益的空间异质性：福利改善范围为1至15%%，而完全流动性下则是均匀收益。（JEL H54, H76, O18, R23, R42, R53）

articles.title_en: Improving Women’s Mental Health during a Pandemic
articles.title_cn: 改善疫情期间的女性心理健康
articles.abstract_en: This paper evaluates a randomized, over-the-phone counseling intervention aimed at mitigating the mental health impact of COVID-19 on a sample of 2,402 women across 357 villages in Bangladesh. We find that the provision of two hours of mental support plus information on COVID-19 improves mental health ten months postintervention, leading to reductions of 20 percent in the prevalence of moderate and severe stress and 33 percent in depression. Our results suggest that this type of low-cost intervention ($14 per person) can be effective in providing rapid psychological support to vulnerable groups in times of crises. (JEL I12, I18, I31, J16, O12, O15)
articles.abstract_cn: 本文评估了一项随机、电话咨询干预措施，旨在缓解COVID-19对孟加拉国357个村庄中2,402名女性样本的心理健康影响。我们发现，提供两小时的心理支持加上COVID-19相关信息，在干预后十个月改善了心理健康，使中度和重度压力的患病率降低了20%，抑郁症降低了33%。我们的结果表明，这种低成本干预（每人14美元）在危机时期可以有效地为弱势群体提供快速心理支持。（JEL I12, I18, I31, J16, O12, O15）

articles.title_en: The Employment Effects of Ethnic Politics
articles.title_cn: 族群政治对就业的影响
articles.abstract_en: We study the labor market consequences of ethnic politics in African democracies. Using subnational georeferenced data from 15 countries from 1996 to 2017, we compare individuals from ethnicities linked to parties at the margin of electing a representative in the national parliament. Having a local ethnic party politician in parliament increases the likelihood of being employed by 2–3 percentage points. The effect is concentrated in the agricultural sector and mostly driven by self-employment, suggesting increased access to land as the main channel. We also show that religion and age are salient markers in African politics that trigger similar employment effects. (JEL D72, J15, J23, J43, O15, O17, Z12)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究了非洲民主国家中族群政治对劳动力市场的影响。利用1996年至2017年15个国家的次国家地理参考数据，我们比较了与在国民议会选举中处于当选边缘的政党相关联的族群个体。在议会中拥有一位地方族群政党政治家，会使就业可能性提高2-3个百分点。这一效应集中在农业部门，且主要由自雇就业驱动，表明增加土地获取是主要渠道。我们还表明，宗教和年龄是非洲政治中引发类似就业效应的显著标志。(JEL D72, J15, J23, J43, O15, O17, Z12)

articles.title_en: The Impact of Cash Transfers to Poor Mothers on Family Structure and Maternal Well-Being
articles.title_cn: 现金转移支付对贫困母亲家庭结构和母亲福祉的影响
articles.abstract_en: We use newly collected data for 16,000 women who applied for Mothers’ Pensions, America’s first welfare program, to investigate the effect of means-tested cash transfers on lifetime family structure and maternal well-being. In the short term, cash transfers delayed marriage and lowered geographic mobility. In the long run, transfers had no impact on the probability of remarriage, spouse quality, or fertility. Cash transfers did not affect women’s well-being, measured by longevity and family income in 1940. Given the lack of significant negative behavioral impacts, the benefits of transfers appear to exceed costs if they have—even modest—positive impacts on children. (JEL I31, I32, I38, J13, J16, N32, R23)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们利用新收集的约16,000名申请母亲养老金（美国第一个福利计划）的女性数据，研究经济状况调查式现金转移支付对终身家庭结构和母亲福祉的影响。短期内，现金转移支付推迟了婚姻并降低了地理流动性。长期来看，转移支付对再婚概率、配偶质量或生育率没有影响。现金转移支付并未影响女性的福祉，以寿命和1940年家庭收入衡量。鉴于缺乏显著的负面行为影响，如果转移支付对儿童有——即使是适度的——积极影响，那么转移支付的收益似乎超过成本。(JEL I31, I32, I38, J13, J16, N32, R23)

articles.title_en: Maternal Dengue and Health Outcomes of Children
articles.title_cn: 母体登革热与儿童健康结果
articles.abstract_en: We study the effect of maternal dengue infections on birth outcomes using linked administrative records from Brazil estimating maternal fixed-effect specifications. In contrast to previous studies, we find robust evidence for the negative effect of dengue infections on birth weight (BW). The effect is particularly pronounced at lower parts of the BW distribution, with an increase of 15 percent, 67 percent, and 133 percent for low, very low, and extremely low BW, respectively. We also document large increases in children’s hospitalizations and medical expenditures for up to three years after birth. (JEL I12, I18, J13, J16, O15)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们利用巴西的关联行政记录，通过估计母亲固定效应模型，研究了母体登革热感染对出生结果的影响。与以往研究相反，我们发现了登革热感染对出生体重（BW）负面影响的稳健证据。这种影响在出生体重分布的低端尤为显著，低出生体重、极低出生体重和超低出生体重的风险分别增加了15%、67%和133%。我们还记录了儿童出生后三年内住院和医疗支出的大幅增加。（JEL I12, I18, J13, J16, O15）
